newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London quiet ahead of expiry.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London quiet ahead of expiry.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London edged higher in quiet trading on Thursday, with dealers' eyes firmly fixed on Friday's Nikkei future and options expiry.
"It's generally been very quiet as it has been for a long time," one dealer said.
The Nikkei 50 index in London was up 2.43 points at 1,391.31 at the close in London, after the Nikkei 225 fell 127.11 points to 20,443.93.
"People are standing on the sidelines for the moment, waiting for tomorrow," the dealer added.
